scenarios.title: Delivered job no longer prevents restocking
steps: On isolated server provide real NPC corp BPO, minerals and ISK
Install one native manufacturing job, wait READY, deliver one full stack
Sell that physical item on native Rust market, purchase from player and record ledger IDs
Run next A-Life/native factory decision after cooldown
expected: Historical job status 4 is not counted as WIP
One new native manufacturing operation is prepared when actual station+escrow inventory is below the target
Only one additional material and ISK debit occurs when native install is confirmed
requiredEvidence: original sale order, filled receipt, wallet transfer

scenarios.title: Paused native job cannot duplicate production
steps: Start one real industry job for an NPC corporation
Pause it through native industry mechanism, retaining materials/job reservation
Run planner and economic director repeatedly
expected: Status 2 remains WIP and no second job starts
No additional materials or ISK debit while paused
requiredEvidence: corporate ISK journal before and after

scenarios.title: READY job counts until delivery
steps: Install real manufacturing job and advance isolated test clock to READY
Inspect same native job before delivery
Run planner and director
expected: Status 3 is counted as in-progress supply
A second factory install does not occur

scenarios.title: Wrong-station and cancelled jobs do not conceal local scarcity
steps: Create one cancelled or delivered historical job
Create active manufacturing job at another station for same corporation and type
Read target station demand
expected: Jobs at different stations do not satisfy local stock
Delivered or cancelled historical jobs are excluded from in-progress supply
Only real local physical stock and open escrow orders count

scenarios.title: Missing active job station/activity fails closed
steps: Supply an active industry record without stationID/facilityID or activityID in disposable GameStore
Enable A-Life or manual manufacturing preparation
expected: Planner returns NATIVE_ACTIVE_JOB_SCOPE_UNVERIFIED
No new job, wallet debit or minerals debit

scenarios.title: Duplicate and corrupted native item rows block manufacturing
steps: Duplicate one native itemID in a disposable read fixture
Repeat with negative or fractional mineral quantity
Attempt NPC manufacturing preparation
expected: Planner reports NATIVE_ITEM_PROVENANCE_UNVERIFIED
No speculative job or free minerals are created

scenarios.title: Lost install ACK does not create a second job
steps: Let the native transaction install and debit once
Suppress install RPC success acknowledgement after durable commit
Restart director and tick same operation
expected: Journal stays INSTALL_UNKNOWN with explicit operator reconciliation
No second install, material withdrawal or ISK debit

scenarios.title: Repeated delivery/restart retains single physical output
steps: Produce and deliver real industry batch to station
Restart persistence worker after native output commit
Replay delivery callback or director tick
expected: Output itemID is unique and quantity does not increase
Journal and native owner/custody remain consistent

scenarios.title: Five sequential complete sale cycles maintain conservation
steps: On isolated station enable one allowed NPC ammo product and cap stock
Run five manufacture→deliver→escrow→full-stack market sale→restock iterations
Restart GameStore and Rust between cycles 2 and 3
expected: Every manufactured item has exactly one source job and one sale receipt
Total material and corporate ISK debits equal installs and credited buyer payments
Zero duplicated goods, negative wallet balances or ghost WIP

scenarios.title: Two NPC corporations cannot reuse another factory's WIP
steps: Place two NPC corporation factories at one station with same product type
Create an active native job for only corporation A
Run B's manufacturing planner with identical target
expected: A's pending output does not satisfy B's demand
Both corporations' BPO and ISK remain isolated
